Subject : Proper handling of cases before Consumer Forums - regarding

Reference :_ This office Circular No. LC-9(12)2013/CPFC Ref/Pt/3865
dated 16.5.2014 (available at S.No.118) , Circular No. LC-
2(990)2015/MH/10588 dated 12.06.2015

Sir/Madam,

Please refer to this office circulars referred to above vide which comprehensive
guidelines on handling of legal cases were issued.

pas It is observed that inspite of detailed instructions on handling of the Consumer
Forum Cases, the performance of field offices in defending cases before Consumer forum
is not very encouraging and the offices are not following the directions in true spirit.

33 It is also a matter of serious concern that there is a steep rise in number of
consumer forum cases. But, the cases are not being defended properly at the level of
District Forums leading to passing of adverse orders by District Forum which are rarely
reversed by Appellate Courts and set a bad precedent for other cases. It is pertinent to
mention that these cases are mostly related to deficiency in service/claim settlement/
Pension scheme and, therefore, can not be neglected.

4. Needless to say, there is urgent requirement to focus attention on the Consumer
Forum cases and to ensure that the department is defended effectively in these cases.

5. Zonal ACCs and RPFC/OICs must review the status of Consumer Forum cases
personally atleast twice a month. It should be ensured that proper written
statement/Counter Reply is filed in each case describing the relevant provision of Act
and Scheme. The Forum should also be apprised of the mandate of the Act and be
requested to pass orders as per prescribed provisions.

6. It is reiterated that the above circulars should scrupulously be followed by the
field functionaries for meticulous handling of all legal cases in their jurisdiction.

Yours faithfully,

(Dr. S.K. Thakur)
Addi. Central P. F. Commissioner (Legal)
